# Studio Twenty Six

> A creative art salon at 5303 Claremont Ave, Oakland, California. Est. 2026. Founded by artist Tescia Seufferlein.

Studio Twenty Six (also called Studio 26) is a community art studio for classes, costumes, happenings, and communal making. Tagline: Come find your creative eye. No experience required. Supplies included. Sliding scale available by email.

## Contact
- Site: https://studio26ca.com
- Email: Studiotwentysix.ca@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/studio26ca/
- Location: 5303 Claremont Ave, Oakland, CA

## Classes
- Peace Love Draw — figure drawing, $25, typically Wednesday evenings
- Wake and Make — Sunday morning collage, $40
- Art Church — live choir + making, $50, Sundays
- The Craft Show — costume embellishment, $55
- Paint the Town — paint night, $55
- Ride or Dye — dye / textile workshop, $65

Sign up at https://studio26ca.com/site/book.html
Class list: https://studio26ca.com/site/classes.html
About Tess: https://studio26ca.com/site/about.html
Happenings and private events: https://studio26ca.com/site/happenings.html

## Facts
- Not The Art Way, HIGH ART, or Space Art Bus
- Camps, shop, memberships, and the art bus are not public products
- First public class: Peace Love Draw, August 19, 2026
- Opening Block Party: September 19, 2026
